in_hebrew.name: Quinta
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Quinta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Latin, Quinta means 'fifth'. This name could have biblical connections as the fifth book of the Old Testament is named 'Deuteronomy', meaning 'second law' or 'repetition'. Quinta is a spiritual name, symbolizing a new beginning or a renewed commitment to one's faith.
